newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian stocks extend gains in lively trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian stocks extend gains in lively trade.

text.p: Shares continued to rise sharply in busy trade on Lithuania's bourse on Friday.
The overall volume on the central market was 4,858,787 litas while the Group A index, which traces the bourse's 35 most active listings, gained 328.9 points to a record high of 3,242.25.
But dealers cautioned that the recent bull run may be losing steam.
"When the prices rise like they have recently, shareholders are keen to sell...the market is probably stabilising now and it doesn't look like prices will rise much more," a dealer said.
Birzai Milk dairy rose to 13.68 litas from 11.4 litas in trade of 364,038 litas while Lithuanian Gas saw its shares rise to 2.96 litas from 2.47 litas in trade worth 833,423 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese maker rose to 44.78 litas from 37.32 litas in a deal worth 163,626 litas.
Hermis Bank ended unchanged at 240 litas in turnover of 486,720 litas and Vilnius Bank was also stable at 260 litas in turnover totalling 131,300.
Ukio bank saw its shares drop to 45 litas from 45.61 in turnover of 427,500 litas.
Bloc trades worth 2,142,501 were made on Friday. The largest one involved Savings bank, which saw 825,000 litas worth of it shares change hands at the price of 165 litas.
Volume on the secondary T-bill market was 620,068 litas.
